command: node --input-type=module -e <exact receiver-v2.mjs text> <JSON with exact cli/deck/focus/receiver strings and expected CLI SHA256>
qualification_boundary: Exact path-based ESM sources served by declared synchronous registerHooks; child argv and pipes are actual Node. No filesystem-source or browser claim.
controlled_errors: stdin EIO is an explicit fixture stream error; stdout close is a real native pipe without a receiving sink.
input_byte_interpretation: For openStdin:true and controlledStdinError:true records, inputBytes/inputSha256 identify the prepared default fixture, not bytes transmitted. The receiver sends zero stdin bytes in those controls. In ordinary input cases those fields bind bytes actually written.
